🎬 Dolby Atmos is everywhere.

Your TV has it. Your headphones have it. Netflix says your favorite show has it.

But... is it actually Dolby Atmos?

In this episode, Caya dives into the 70-year history of surround sound—from Cinerama and Dolby Stereo to Dolby Digital, DTS, and Atmos—to uncover what Atmos really is, why it's become the default marketing label, and why most people may never hear the real thing.

We also build a home theater, compare audio formats, install ceiling speakers, and answer the question: is Dolby Atmos actually worth it?
